overview: Track ICP neuron staking rewards with daily sync, portfolio aggregation, historical import, and light/dark themes.
features: Daily reward snapshots synced from IC governance
Portfolio dashboard with total staked, maturity, and blended APY
Paste-in historical data import with DD/MM/YYYY parsing
Merge maturity event detection distinct from disbursements
Light and dark theme toggle persisted per user
Activity feed with editable snapshots and CSV export
Monthly breakdown charts and per-neuron APY
